verdict.rationale: Enterprise licensing is a fair question for a commercial coding agent, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only usage-limit tiers (e.g., a 'Power users & agent-heavy workflows' tier) and priority model access. It never mentions an enterprise license, SSO, or commercial support for an organization-wide rollout.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can license an enterprise deployment with SSO and commercial support for organization-wide rollout
